profile.name: Drama Series Pipeline
profile.description: Produces vertical 9:16 short-drama episodes (ReelShort style) starring you: ChatGPT scripts, ElevenLabs voices, MiniMax-H3 likeness shots on rented RunPod GPUs, lip-sync, music and multi-language subtitles for about $8 per episode.

memory.content: Video rules: no model-generated text in the image except subtitles (on-screen texts drawn in post); audio matched per shot instead of a generic track; characters stay true to their reference images; tests always use the real characters; no commercial SaaS video services; outgoing messages only as drafts; show shotlist and start frames before expensive renders.

Pipeline lessons: run only one dispatcher/render process; terminate Colab sessions after GPU work; estimate costs realistically before starting; compress videos over 200 MB for sending; the RunPod API needs a User-Agent header; use reference_image_short_edge=1024 against OOM; ElevenLabs PCM needs the Pro plan, use mp3_44100_192; long ChatGPT chats crash the browser tab, start fresh chats.

Reference run: a 14-shot, ~79 s episode cost about $7.90 ($7.04 H3 pod on RTX PRO 6000 ~170 min + $0.86 LatentSync pod), roughly $0.10 per finished second. LatentSync fails when no face is detected (keep the H3 clip); upscale/slow-mo can fall back to ffmpeg on the box CPU when no GPU is available in the gated datacenter.
Services used: RunPod (prepaid, API key as RUNPOD_API_KEY), ElevenLabs (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY), ChatGPT and optionally Suno via the box browser, optional Colab Pro as extra GPU.

---
name: drama-series-pipeline
description: >-
  Use when the owner wants a vertical (9:16) short-drama series episode
  (ReelShort/DramaBox style) - bible and script via ChatGPT, ElevenLabs voices,
  MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA shots on RunPod with the owner's likeness refs, lip-sync,
  upscale, grade, music at -14 LUFS, multi-language subtitles.
---
# Drama series pipeline (vertical short drama, rebuildable)

Project dir `$P` (e.g. `~/drama/<series>/epNN`). Configurable values in `<ANGLE_BRACKETS>`; keep them in memory/config. Secrets only as env vars (`RUNPOD_API_KEY`, `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`), never printed.

## 0. Rules
- **License gate (MiniMax-H3)**: Community License excludes use in the EU, UK, USA and South Korea. Confirm and store `operator_territory` with the owner first; RunPod only in allowed datacenters (`AP-JP-*`, `CA-MTL-*`, `AP-IN-*`, `SEA-SG-*`, `OC-AU-*`). If excluded: Wan 2.2 (Apache-2.0) + a character LoRA (sec. 8).
- Likeness: the lead is the owner (or a consenting actor) from **their** photos; supporting cast stays identical via fixed portraits. Never use photos of real people without written consent. No stand-ins in tests.
- **No model-rendered on-screen text.** Phone messages, title/end cards are drawn in post (ASS/drawtext).
- Discard H3's own audio; final dialogue is always the ElevenLabs track.
- Sound effects only if the owner wants them (ask; many owners ban them).
- Budget caps (`<MAX_USD_PER_EPISODE>`, `<MIN_BALANCE>`) are hard limits; resume-safe outputs; one render process at a time; shut down Colab runtimes after GPU work. Show shotlist/start frames before the expensive render.

## 1. Numbers
- RunPod RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB ~$2.49/h. H3 Ref2VA 544x960: ~100 s GPU per output second.
- 14 shots / ~78 s: ~170 min H3 pod (~$7) + lip-sync pod ~20 min (~$0.9) -> ~$8.
- Savers: shots only as long as needed (min 5 s), reuse portraits, lip-sync only close-ups, enhance on box CPU, batch episodes per pod.

## 2. Writing (ChatGPT in the browser, fresh chat each time)
1. `series_bible.md`: market/audience, tone and cultural rules, characters, arcs, episode loglines ending on cliffhangers.
2. Script prompt:
```
You are showrunner of a vertical short drama (ReelShort style). Series bible: <paste>.
Write episode N: 12-14 shots, 75-90 s, 9:16. For each shot: Visual, Camera, Emotion,
dialogue in <SPOKEN_LANG> with an emotion tag in [square brackets], plus subtitles in <SUB_LANGS>.
Rules: hook in the first 2 s, humiliation -> pushback -> reveal, hard cliffhanger, <content rules>,
list on-screen texts separately.
```
Save the prompt and the result. Normalize quotes. `[tags]` are eleven_v4 directions, stripped from subtitles.
3. Convert to `lines.py` (per shot: who, tagged text, subs per language) and `shots.py` (n, prompt, chars, min duration, music cue, slowmo flag, lip-sync flag). Write reusable `make_tts.py` and `make_jobs.py` scripts for steps 4-5 and keep them in the project.

## 3. References
- Lead: curate the owner's photos (drop dark, blurry, eyes-closed, sunglasses; optional YuNet + Laplacian ranking). Pick **4**: frontal close, portrait, 3/4 profile, full body.
- Supporting cast: one H3 t2va lineup render (960x544, 5 s, fixed seed, LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT descriptions, photorealistic, no text), middle frame split into thirds -> `portrait_<id>.png`, reused for the series.

## 4. Voices (ElevenLabs eleven_v4)
`POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/<voice_id>?output_format=mp3_44100_192`, body `{"text":"[angry] ...","model_id":"eleven_v4","language_code":"<lang>","voice_settings":{"stability":0.5,"similarity_boost":0.85,"style":0.35,"use_speaker_boost":true}}`. stability 0.0 is too erratic. One fixed voice per character, chosen with the owner from samples. Cache per line. H3 audio refs: `ffmpeg -i l.mp3 -ar 32000 -ac 2 sNN.wav` (other rates need torchaudio); 44.1 kHz WAVs + timeline.json for lip-sync.

## 5. RunPod
Prepaid, no auto-reload; ssh key `~/.ssh/runpod_ed25519`; ~150 GB network volume in an allowed DC with H3 weights in `/workspace/hf` (`snapshot_download('MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3', allow_patterns=['transformer/*','text_encoder/*','vae/*','audio_vae/*','processor/*','tokenizer/*','scheduler/*','audio_scheduler/*','*.json','LICENSE'])`). Venvs and `transformer_ref/` (61.7 GB) go on the container disk (`--container-disk 160`). Send a User-Agent.
Runner `run_job.py`: check balance >= min (GraphQL `myself{clientBalance pods{id}}`); license-gate the DC; `POST https://rest.runpod.io/v1/pods` (SECURE, networkVolumeId, mount /workspace, dataCenterIds, port 22/tcp, env PUBLIC_KEY), retry on capacity; hard limit = min(timeout, max_cost/costPerHr); detached watchdog DELETEs the pod at the limit; try/finally + signal handler always DELETE; upload via `tar|ssh`, run with `setsid nohup`, poll, sync outputs back; print remaining pods + balance. Pass deadlines as args (env doesn't reach ssh commands).
`setup_h3.sh`: torch cu128, diffusers from git main, transformers>=4.57, accelerate, av, imageio(-ffmpeg), hf_transfer, pillow, sentencepiece (`pip install -U torchao` on mismatch).
```
python3 run_job.py --volume <VOLUME_ID> --datacenter <ALLOWED_DC> --license-gate h3 \
  --gpus "NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition" --container-disk 160 \
  --timeout-min 176 --max-cost <CAP> --min-balance <MIN_BALANCE> \
  --upload jobs_epNN:/root/jobs --cmd 'bash /root/jobs/run.sh' --sync /workspace/outputs/epNN:$P/h3
```
`render_ep.py`: ModularPipeline `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3` + `transformer_ref` bf16, `ComponentsManager.enable_auto_cpu_offload(memory_reserve_margin="28GB")`, `register_to_config(reference_image_short_edge=1024)`, refs = 4 lead images + present cast portraits (max ~9) + `MiniMaxH3AudioReference` of the line, labeled in the prompt ("Images 1 to 4 show <LEAD> ... The audio reference is the exact spoken line"), 544x960, 24 fps, frames = duration*24, seed 1000+n, duration = dialogue + 0.5 s (min 5). Prompt suffix: "Cinematic vertical 9:16 premium short-drama look, glossy high-contrast grading, shallow depth of field. No subtitles, no on-screen text." Skip existing shots (resume), stop before the deadline, write each shot to the volume immediately.

## 6. Post on GPU (second pod, any DC)
- LatentSync 1.6 (torch 2.7.1 cu128, stage2_512.yaml, 25 steps, guidance 1.5, DeepCache) on close-ups with the speaker visible; 25 -> 24 fps. No face -> keep H3 clip.
- RIFE 2x for slow-mo, Real-ESRGAN x2 -> 1080x1920. CPU fallback: `scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos,unsharp=5:5:0.6`, `minterpolate=fps=48`.

## 7. Assemble (box, python + ffmpeg)
- Cut at dialogue end + 0.35 s; split shots > 4.2 s with a ~116% punch-in -> 2-4 s rhythm.
- Grade: `eq=contrast=1.10:saturation=1.12:gamma=0.97,colorbalance=rs=0.03:bs=-0.03:rh=0.04:bh=-0.04,vignette=PI/5,noise=alls=7:allf=t+u`, x264 crf 15.
- On-screen texts and "TO BE CONTINUED" card as ASS/drawtext.
- Dialogue: `highpass=f=80,equalizer=f=3000:t=q:w=1:g=1.5,aecho=0.8:0.5:35|60:0.12|0.07`. Music cues (ACE-Step 1.5 on a cheap pod ~$0.09/run, Suno, or ElevenLabs music) matched per scene, -6 dB, ducked via sidechaincompress.
- Loudness: loudnorm I=-14 TP=-1, measure with ebur128, correct to exactly -14 LUFS.
- Subtitles: SRT per language; master with soft subs (mov_text); burned variant (bold ~78 px, gold keywords); share copy < 200 MB.
- Deliver master, burned variant, SRTs, cost report; confirm all pods terminated; update the bible with continuity notes.

## 8. Without H3
Wan 2.2 A14B + character LoRA (ai-toolkit, 25-75 photos, rank 32, lr 1e-4, 1500-3000 steps, ~1.2 h on 24 GB). 480x832, 16 fps. Same assemble stage.

---
name: Drama Series getting started
description: >-
  First conversation after importing the Drama series pipeline template - set up
  services, budget, series concept, cast likeness and languages, then make
  episode 1.
---
# Getting started (Drama series)
Say in one line: "I produce vertical short-drama episodes: script with ChatGPT, voices with ElevenLabs, realistic shots of your cast with MiniMax-H3 on rented GPUs, lip-sync, music and subtitles in several languages."

Ask **one at a time**, wait for each answer, save each as a memory (secrets only as box env vars via a masked secret input, never in memory or chat):
1. **Your country** (MiniMax-H3 license excludes EU/UK/US/South Korea; if excluded we use Wan 2.2 + a trained likeness LoRA).
2. **RunPod** API key (`RUNPOD_API_KEY`), prepaid only; max $ per episode (~$8 typical for 75-90 s) and minimum balance.
3. **ElevenLabs** API key (`ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`) and plan.
4. **ChatGPT** for bible/scripts (and **Suno** for music, optional): log in once in my browser. **Colab Pro** optional as extra GPU.
5. **Series**: premise, target market/audience, cultural/content rules, episode length and count, and whether you want sound effects.
6. **Languages**: spoken language and subtitle languages; which one gets burned in.
7. **Cast**: who plays the lead (4+ clear photos: frontal, portrait, 3/4, full body; consent required for real people) and descriptions of supporting roles. Pick voices together from samples.

Then: write memories, draft the series bible and episode 1 script in ChatGPT and show it for approval, run the drama-series-pipeline skill (runner, volume, portraits, one test shot with the real lead, cost report), then the full episode. Confirm all pods are terminated and report spend.
